newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece, Russia to sign energy cooperation protocol.
newsitem.headline: Greece, Russia to sign energy cooperation protocol.

text.p: Russia and Greece announced on Monday that they will sign an energy cooperation protocol, the semi-official Athens News Agency (ANA) said.
Development Minister Vasso Papandreou and visiting Russian Energy Minister Peter Rodionov announced the agreement at a joint press conference, it said.

"The protocol provides for the formation of a working group to discuss issues related to the Burgas-Alexandroupolis oil pipeline and the extension of the natural gas network to the Greek-Albanian border," ANA said.

Rodionov is visiting Greece to inaugurate with Greek Prime Minister Costas Simitis on Wednesday a pipeline bringing natural gas from Russia to Greece. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
